label: 🔄 Cast type
description: Change the data type of a column. Failed casts become NULL by default.

targetType.label: Target type
targetType.help: Physical types (integer / double / string / boolean / date / datetime) change how the column is stored. Meta-types (index, percentage, currency, scientific, hex, uuid, email, url, ip, phone, country, color, timezone) keep the same storage but add semantic constraints — duplicates flagged for index, invalid entries highlighted in red, formatted display, etc. The cast UI shows the most likely fits first based on automatic detection.

strict.label: Strict (fail on bad values)
strict.help: Off: failed casts become NULL. On: pipeline fails on first bad value.
